verdict.rationale: Fin has a documented public API: the Fin Agent API lets you call Fin programmatically, the Fin API platform exposes answer generation and knowledge retrieval, and an official TypeScript SDK wraps the Intercom APIs, including AI content endpoints. Coverage is limited because the core orchestration endpoints (Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, Escalate to a human) are documented as Preview-only, and no OpenAPI spec was found at fin.ai. missing for 10: general availability of the orchestration endpoints, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Fin end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Fin can be accessed programmatically via an API.
The new orchestration endpoints — Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, and Escalate to a human — are currently available in the Preview API version only.
The Fin API platform includes APIs for answer generation and knowledge retrieval, available as a set or independently.
The Intercom TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Intercom APIs from TypeScript.
